record.question: 'The Kono statement' reappeared recently is an issue between
options: Russia and United States of America
record.explanation: Answer A: Japan and Korea. The Kono Statement concerns Japan's wartime military comfort-women issue and relations with the Republic of Korea (South Korea). Japan's original June 2014 review is explicitly about exchanges between Japan and the Republic of Korea. Historical/source note: Korea here means the Republic of Korea (South Korea); historical 2014 controversy. Reference: https://www.mofa.go.jp/files/100136721.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
